items.title: Jim Galloway interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Diego, California, February 15, 1998
items.q: Roy Hargrove is a really great young trumpet player

ctx.x: He knows the roots of the music. He knows its origins. And he’s a very contemporary player, but to me he’s full of that passion and emotion and all the magic things. And Ray does it for me. And I’m sure I could think of a bunch more. Roy Hargrove is a really great young trumpet player, and again, he’s got this, it’s like a fanaticism, but playing, he’s got this huge passionate desire to play the horn. And I don’t want to idealize that sort of thing. I don’t mean to get over a message oh it’s so wonderful to be…
Barron’s playing and he has a sound, and the piano is an intimate sort of — but Kenny Barron. And it would take me a little time just to —
